### Upload HTML Content to Cloudfront S3 Bucket

s3://jerome-dixon.io/mushin-solutions/quicksight_cross_account.html


### Get Signed Cloudfront URL

-   Generate signed URL for browsing (Python code):

```{python eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE}

from cryptography.hazmat.backends import default_backend
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes, serialization, asymmetric
from botocore.signers import CloudFrontSigner
import datetime

def rsa_signer(message):
    with open('webR_private_key.pem', 'rb') as key_file:
        private_key = serialization.load_pem_private_key(
            key_file.read(), password=None, backend=default_backend())
    return private_key.sign(message, asymmetric.padding.PKCS1v15(), hashes.SHA1())

key_id = 'KH0ZA0Z2LKGN9'
url = 'https://d39wkmcwjc0jh4.cloudfront.net/mushin-solutions/quicksight_cross_account.html'
expiration = datetime.datetime.utcnow() + datetime.timedelta(days=5)

cf_signer = CloudFrontSigner(key_id, rsa_signer)
signed_url = cf_signer.generate_presigned_url(url, date_less_than=expiration)
print(signed_url)

```


```{r}

library(reticulate)

browseURL(py$signed_url)

```
